28. 25名教师和140名学生的平均身高为150 cm。若学生的平均身高为145 cm，则教师的平均身高为
A. 151 cm
B. 155 cm
C. 176 cm
D. 178 cm
reasoning: Let total number of individuals = 25 teachers + 140 students = 165. Overall average = 150 cm → total height = 150 × 165 = 24750 cm. Students’ total height = 145 × 140 = 20300 cm. Teachers’ total height = 24750 − 20300 = 4450 cm. Teacher average = 4450 ÷ 25 = 178 cm, which corresponds to option D.
